name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Higher Education
description: Financial assistance provided to students belonging to economically weaker sections pursuing post-secondary or undergraduate technical and general higher education courses across India.
simplified_description: You can get financial support for your college tuition if you are an undergraduate student with family income under ₹2.5 lakh.
benefits: Full coverage of maintenance allowance and non-refundable tuition fees up to ₹50,000 annually.

name: Karnataka State Post-Matric Merit Scholarship
description: State-specific merit-cum-means scholarship for meritorious students pursuing engineering, medical, or degree courses in recognized institutions within Karnataka.
simplified_description: If you live in Karnataka, study engineering or degree courses, and your family earns less than ₹2.0 lakh, you get a yearly stipend.
benefits: Stipend of ₹25,000 per year plus fee reimbursement.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
description: Central sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to enable them to procure agricultural inputs.
simplified_description: Land-owning farmers get ₹6,000 every year directly in their bank accounts in three equal installments.
benefits: Direct bank transfer of ₹6,000 per year in 3 tranches of ₹2,000.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban / Gramin)
description: Housing scheme aimed at providing pucca houses with basic amenities to homeless families and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
simplified_description: Get financial help to build or buy a home if your household income is under ₹3.0 lakh and you do not own a pucca house.
benefits: Interest subsidy of up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loans.

name: Deendayal Disability Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
description: Financial assistance to voluntary organizations and individuals with benchmark disabilities for education, vocational training, and assistive equipment.
simplified_description: Support for persons with disabilities (40%+ benchmark) for education, skill training, and equipment aid.
benefits: Free assistive appliances, vocational training stipend, and educational grants.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (Shishu & Kishor Loan)
description: Provides collateral-free micro-loans to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises for setting up small businesses or purchasing equipment.
simplified_description: Get collateral-free loans up to ₹5 lakh to start or expand a small business, shop, or service enterprise.
benefits: Collateral-free micro loans from ₹50,000 up to ₹5,000,000 at affordable interest rates.

name: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
description: Financial assistance program for female heads of households in Karnataka providing monthly financial aid to empower women.
simplified_description: Women who are designated heads of their households in Karnataka get ₹2,000 every month directly deposited into their bank accounts.
benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹2,000 transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
description: Central scheme awarded to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest drop-outs at Class 8 and encourage higher secondary studies.
simplified_description: School students in Class 9 to 12 receive ₹12,000 per year if family income is below ₹3.5 lakh and they pass the selection test.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for classes 9 through 12.
